title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes; v1.125.0 bumps
author: Priya Raman
description:
Motivation: We have several SDK divergence points across Python/TypeScript/Go around auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This PR consolidates the common auth/retry plumbing, improves streaming ergonomics (single unified stream API surface with cancel/timeout helpers), fixes parity gaps flagged in the SDK audit, and bumps SDK versions to v1.125.0. Changes aim to be backward-compatible for 99% of users; see release notes for migration steps.

Checklist: 
- [x] Unify auth token refresh and injection behavior across SDKs
- [x] Standardize retry/backoff config schema and default behavior
- [x] Improve streaming API ergonomics (auto-reconnect toggle, unified iterator/async iterator behaviour)
- [x] Parity fixes (parameter names, error wrapping) across sdks
- [x] Bump package versions to v1.125.0 and update changelogs
- [x] Add integration tests for streaming + auth renewals

Notes: This PR touches SDK core transport layers; careful review required. Linear tasks ENG-1142 and ENG-1187 track the compatibility checks and docs updates. SUP-7842 is a customer-reported issue where streaming would not re-authenticate when long-lived connections encountered a rotated key; that is addressed here.
commits: refactor(sdk-core): extract unified auth token provider interface
fix(python): add token refresh hook for streaming client
feat(ts): expose StreamClient as async iterable with cancel()
chore(release): bump versions to v1.125.0 and update changelogs
review_comments: Marco Liu: Overall looks good. Please add a small integration test for token rotation during an active stream (edge case SUP-7842).
Priya Raman: Added integration test in sdks/python/tests/test_stream_token_rotation.py and equivalent in ts/go. PTAL.

Elena Garcia: In TS StreamClient, iterator usage felt awkward when used with existing for-await-of loops; thanks for exposing async iterator. One nit: document cancel() behavior (does it close underlying transport?).
Priya Raman: Documented cancel() semantics in StreamClient.ts and updated docs/sdks/compatibility.md. Cancel will close transport and surface a StreamCanceled error.
Samir Patel: Linter flagged a minor style issue in go provider; fixed. Also confirm that retry defaults are not stricter than before (we preserve previous behavior unless customer overrides).
CI Bot: lint(ts) failed on first run due to import ordering in tokenProvider.ts — fixed in second commit. All checks now passing.
ci_checks: ci/test: success (python unit + integration, ts unit + e2e, go unit)
ci/lint: initial fail (ts import-order) -> pass after fix
release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TS/Go): Unify auth token provider and automatic token refresh to fix rotated-key streaming failures (SUP-7842).
- Standardized retry/backoff configuration across SDKs (defaults preserved).
- Streaming ergonomics: unified stream client API (async iterator / iterator + cancel()) and clearer error handling.
- Parity fixes: parameter name alignment and error wrapping consistency.
- Bumped SDK versions to v1.125.0.
